commit 98d9c23c5f6323cd31af1e009835b98a3716edb9
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Fri Apr 24 21:34:26 2026 +0000
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Fri Apr 24 21:34:26 2026 +0000

    Bug 2034322 - Cache screen metrics in newmailalert.js to prevent multi-monitor bleed on resize. r=mkmelin
    
    The new immediate-snap logic introduced in Thunderbird 150 caused a boundary-
    crossing race condition in multi-monitor setups.
    
    When the alert window initially spawns and snaps to the bottom-right corner
    of the primary monitor, it sits very close to the monitor boundary. As the DOM
    finishes loading and the window expands horizontally to fit its content, it can
    temporarily bleed over the pixel boundary into the adjacent monitor.
    
    This physical overlap causes the OS to update the window's internal `screen`
    object to the adjacent monitor. When the `resize` listener fires and triggers
    `snapToCorner()` a second time, it erroneously calculates the placement based
    on the adjacent monitor's coordinate space, permanently moving the alert to the
    wrong screen.
    
    This patch caches the initial `screen` metrics the moment the alert loads. By
    anchoring the `snapToCorner()` math to these cached coordinates, the alert
    forces the window back into its original coordinate space on the Virtual
    Desktop, effectively ignoring any temporary screen reassignments by the OS
    during layout expansion.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D296315

diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
index 93bf6c585fa..3eb8ca64f13 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
@@ -70,9 +70,24 @@ async function doOnAlertLoad() {
   const alertImageBox = document.getElementById("alertImageBox");
   alertImageBox.style.minHeight = alertTextBox.scrollHeight + "px";
 
+  // Cache the target screen metrics immediately. If the window expands
+  // and temporarily bleeds into an adjacent monitor during layout,
+  // this anchors our math to the original monitor, preventing an OS hijack.
+  const targetScreen = {
+    availLeft: screen.availLeft,
+    availTop: screen.availTop,
+    availWidth: screen.availWidth,
+    availHeight: screen.availHeight,
+  };
+
   const snapToCorner = () => {
-    const x = screen.availLeft + screen.availWidth - window.outerWidth - 10;
-    const y = screen.availTop + screen.availHeight - window.outerHeight - 10;
+    const x =
+      targetScreen.availLeft + targetScreen.availWidth - window.outerWidth - 10;
+    const y =
+      targetScreen.availTop +
+      targetScreen.availHeight -
+      window.outerHeight -
+      10;
     window.moveTo(x, y);
   };
title: Bug 2034322 - Cache screen metrics in newmailalert.js to prevent multi-monitor bleed on resize. r=mkmelin
